data.name: Stereoscopy
data.detailed_description:
The Ultimate Immersive Home Theater for Desktop and VR

Step into your own private cinema where every movie feels larger than life. Stereoscopy plays ordinary video and 3D-formatted video files in an immersive 3D experience - whether you’re seated at your desk with classic anaglyph glasses or fully immersed inside a virtual reality headset.

Stereoscopy isn’t just a player – it’s the private, jaw-dropping cinema you’ve always wanted. Turn any video into an unforgettable 3D spectacle, tonight.

Overview

  • Native playback up to 8K resolution with 4K texture sampling

  • Real-time ray tracing, global illumination, dynamic shadows, volumetric fog, god-rays, particle streams and screen-space reflections

  • Free roam and theater seating

  • Eight powerful 3D modes: Anaglyph, Half/Full Side-By-Side → Anaglyph, Top-Bottom → Anaglyph, Half/Full Side-by-Side, Top-Bottom, and Standard 2D

  • In VR: perfect left/right-eye separation for flawless stereoscopic 3D with zero crosstalk

  • On desktop: real-time anaglyph rendering (red-cyan, amber-blue, green-magenta and more)

Cinema-Quality Audio

  • Supports up to 10.2-channel surround sound (including 7.2, 5.1, 2.1, stereo)

  • Dolby, DTS and THX pass-through decoding

  • Up to 192-bit depth for pristine clarity

  • Audio modes:
    • Direct – faithful passthrough of the original audio tracks
    • World Spatial Audio – true 3D positional sound placed throughout the virtual theater with intelligent downmixing across low, mid and full-range virtual speakers

A Living, Breathing Theater

Walk, jump, sit or stand inside stunning virtual environments that react to your movie.

  • Realtime Lighting and Volume level controls

  • Projection screen and projector emit realistic light that spills into the room

  • Auto-dim/restore theater lighting when you hit play or pause (fully configurable)

  • Optional projector beam with visible particle rays and cinematic god-rays

  • Seat beacons to help you find the perfect spot to watch – just walk in or teleport (VR) and your view instantly snaps to the screen

  • Door beacons to exit the Theater - – just walk in or teleport (VR) to a door and you are prompted to exit

  • Two beautifully detailed theaters included: an intimate Screening Room and a massive, atmospheric Army Warehouse

  • Change your theater on the fly using the Theater Browser

Designed for Comfort and Control

  • Compatibility: Windows 11, desktop monitors, and OpenXR compatible XR/VR/AR headsets (with or without controllers)

  • Partial input support: keyboard + mouse, gamepads, and VR motion controllers

  • Intuitive Video Remote (desktop or VR) for play/pause, seek, restart, volume, 3D mode, audio mode and repeat

  • Built-in file browser

  • Theater selector

  • Auto-Play resumes your last video exactly where you left off

  • Auto-Repeat for endless loops

data.short_description: A virtual theater experience for Desktop PC with VR support - capable of playing Standard and 3D Video files. Supports Keyboard/Mouse, Gamepad, and XR Controllers.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Required
  • VR Support: OpenXR Compatible XR/VR/AR

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
